alert_mesagem: For a better game experience, consider playing the basic tutorial.
cap1_lvl1_intro: Mission report NB-2000 , pilot %@, control number 225: after my last battle, I lost the poor connection I had with earth, I'm 3000 light years away from earth, not a long time ago I could intercept piece of an enemy's message. My computer on board took a little while but could finally decrypt it, and two words were very well clear: Attack and Earth. From now on, I'm starting my journey back to my planet, it's going to be tough and full of enemies, and actually, here comes another one...
cap1_lvl3_intro: Mission report NB-2000, pilot %@ , control number 288: I need to refuel, I'm almost out of fuel, I saw close to here a refuelling station, an enemy one, but it doesn't matter, I will need to get there anyway.
cap1_lvl4_ending: Mission report NB-2000, pilot %@ , control number 232: After a few obstacles, I've just reached the station, starting docking for refuelling.
cap1_main_intro: Main processor acessing backup files... file corrupted, initializing file recover... Backup file recovered... Playing backup file... During the last Great Intergalactic War, humanity joined earth, in order to give their last try to save what was still left. Then nebula project was created. Because of the lack of skill from our pilots in fighting due huge electrostatic nebulas, those which limited thier vision and interfered our equipments, the focus of Nebula project was developing a brand new technology that allowed them listening on space. 2000 spaceships were built and 2000 pilots trained, and we now had a chance to win. however, in a hurry to figthing our enemys, we forgot an important fact, which is, due those nebulas interfered our equipments, and we could only localize through the sound, there was a big possibility of our pilots get lost on space. End of file.
cap2_main_intro: Mission report NB-2000, pilot %@, control number 235: The refuelling station is desolate,and not a single equipment is working properly. Maybe the mercenaries that I came across when coming here were taking advantage of the lack of energy and abandonment to steal fuel. I found a message saying that enemies were moving to the center of the galaxy, and coordinates to an unknown planet. I Hope that it's a planet on our solar sistem, as I need to get to earth.
chap1_icarus1: You have less than 5% of fuel. I strongly recommend you to go to the closest refuelling base. Warning: Mercenaries spaceships approaching
chap1_icarus1.2: There are many fuel tanks on space, avoid them as much as possible. Colliding with them may be fatal.
chap1_icarus3: Warning: A huge mercenary ship was seen behind you. Combat is imminent.
chap1_icarus4: You have arrived in the FDE's refuelling base. Starting docking procedure...
chap2_icarus1: According to given coordinates, the destination planet is on this direction.
chap2_icarus2: Warning: This area is known for having some nebulas. Fly carefully and get ready to fight with low visibility.
chap2_icarus3: A big enemy spaceship was seen around the destination planet. Combat is imminent.
chap2_icarus4: Enemy spaceship destroyed. Starting landing procedure on planet.
chap3_icarus1: Pluto is though this direction. The space warp engine is being prepared so we can perform a jump as fast as possible.
chap3_icarus2: Space warp engine status: 100%. Performing warp immediately.
chap3_icarus3: Insufficient energy available for the warp engine. Warp aborted.
chap3_icarus4: Warning: Huge nebula field ahead. Prepare yourself.
chap3_icarus5: We are arriving at Pluto. Enemy`s base is now in range. Combat is imminent.
chap4_icarus1: Warning: Enemy base located at Neptune.
chap4_icarus2: You have arrived at the rings of Saturn. Avoid the rocks that are coming in your direction.
chap4_icarus3: Warning: Enemy base located at Jupiter.
chap4_icarus4: Warning: Enemy base located at Mars.
chap4_icarus5: Arriving at Earth within a few minutes. Trying to estabilish communication with mission`s commander.
chap5_icarus1: To scare all the enemies we need to destroy their mothership. However, the fuselage is really thick.
chap5_icarus2: The best strategy I can think of would be guide it to Sun's surface, and then attack. Be careful, enemies are getting closer.
chap5_icarus3: Enemy mothership approaching rapidly. Now that we are the sun's surface, you can finish it.
chap5_icarus4: Mothership destroyed. Tracing route back to Earth.
chap6_icarus1: Allied spaceships detected. Warning: Avoid hitting the allied ships on a collision course.
chap6_icarus2: Destroying 5 allied spaceships implies on the mission`s critical failure.
chap6_icarus3: Warning: You have fallen into a mercenaries ambush.
chap6_icarus4: That was the last spaceship in the ambush.
chap7_icarus1: Day 0 - Coordinates to destination planet received from commander. Starting mission.
chap7_icarus2: Fleet status: Over 140 million civilian spaceships following you.
chap7_icarus3: Day 152 - Fleet status: Around 300 losses on civilian spaceships. Warning: Enemy ships detected. Prepare for combat.
chap7_icarus4: Day 241 - Fleet status: Casualities are over a thousand. More enemies detected. Prepare for combat.
chap7_icarus5: Day 364 - Fleet status: 10% of the starting spacehips have been destroyed. Running low on supplies. Attention: Destination planet is in sight.
chap7_icarus6: Enemy mothership localized. Prepare for combat.
chap7_icarus7: Mission completed. Initializing landing sequence and planet colonization procedure.
chap8_icarus1: After destroying so many enemies, I might be able to track down where they are comming from. Creating route to their homeworld.
chap8_icarus2: You are approaching the destination planet, identified as Pegasus. Warning: Defense ship sighted.
chap8_icarus3: Enemy destroyed. You have arrived at your destination.
chap9_icarus1: Tracing route to the closest planet rift.
chap9_icarus2: Sir, on a quick analysis I see that this mission implies a 99.9% chance of you not surviving. Are you sure  you want to carry on?
chap9_icarus3: Silence recognized as a confirmation. Warning: The spaceship protecting the planets core is on sight. Prepare to engage.
chap9_icarus4: Sir, it has been an honor.
chap9_icarus5: Your logs were sent back to New Earth. You will never be forgotten.
